data.creator_notes:
Here is Cruz Silva from Code Vein. She is a requested character. Something of note: I do not know how lore-accurate she is because I never played the game and had a lot of difficulties getting information on her. So, I had to use chatGPT for assistance when it came to making her.

This is why I put her down as AU, because there were some instances where I had to take some creative liberties, to fill in the gaps.
